mota.title: One operating model, four delivery lanes
mota.lead: Every project starts from a real need, a verified partner and a delivery path that can be audited.
mota.mission: Turn real needs into executable projects by organising technology, teams, resources and local partners.
mota.vision: A connected project network where regional strengths meet scarce resources in target markets.
mota.it: From sensors and devices to cloud platforms, edge inference and AI agents: technology that makes teams work together.
mota.ai: GenAI synthetic data, edge inference, automation and practical delivery.
mota.aiotTitle: GenAI synthetic data for AIoT devices
mota.aiotBody: A smart-elevator case where scarce failure data is replaced by GenAI-generated synthetic samples, then quantised onto an NPU for on-device inference — private by default, low latency, deployable at the edge.
aiotPoints: Synthetic fault samples instead of expensive field collection
Quantised models that run on low-power NPUs
On-device inference keeps raw sensor data local
